protocol.sample_rule: All tickers on the latest common saved prediction date, no label-based selection; require 44 matched predictions per model.
protocol.reference_rule: Finance features dated before 2023-01-01 only; fixed 1024-row sample with seed 42 for tabular LIME; standardized reference mean and median as sequence baselines.

evaluation.primary: Mean cumulative absolute raw-logit change after removal of top 1..N ranked features/days; higher means stronger model response, not better trading performance.
evaluation.random_control: Mean of 20 random removal orders with seed 42 per input.
evaluation.reference_sensitivity: Top-3 Jaccard overlap between reference mean and median replacement scores.
evaluation.lime_seed_stability: Mean pairwise top-3 Jaccard across seeds 42,43,44.
evaluation.completeness: TreeSHAP reconstruction error and Integrated Gradients convergence delta; not applicable to LIME/occlusion.
evaluation.lime_fidelity: Weighted neighborhood R-squared and absolute error at original input.
evaluation.runtime: Measured explanation time on local CPU; no production latency claim.

constraints: No training, calibration fitting, prediction promotion, holdout reading or database writes.
Exact saved prediction must reproduce within percentage-CSV rounding; refuse mismatch.
LSTM input follows the original export: ten sessions preceding the saved label date, excluding that date.
LIME fits actual historical rows rather than independently sampled synthetic indicators. This is a documented LimeBase neighborhood adaptation, not default LimeTabular.
Deletion, occlusion and IG interpolation can break indicator relationships or temporal continuity. They are synthetic sensitivity diagnostics, not feasible market scenarios or causal effects.
TreeSHAP and LIME have different reference conventions. Do not rank magnitudes or completeness across them.
The protocol defines no universal winner or model-accuracy gain. Report all results and limitations, not a post-selected best case.
